what_changed: Edition 2: technical revision; Annex A (system A/CHAdeMO, now incl. charging/discharging station) and Annex B (system B/GB) DC-charging digital communication updated in line with IEC 61851-23:2023
note: Revision of existing message sets on existing CAN-based links; no new stack named in the abstract. DERIVED.

what_changed: Final rule establishing FMVSS 305a (replacing 305; 305 amended to apply unless certified to 305a): REESS overcharge/over-discharge/over-temperature/overcurrent protection, warnings for REESS control malfunction and thermal event (documented under new Part 561), light and heavy vehicles
note: One act amending B33 (FMVSS 305) and establishing B34 (305a): recorded once under B33, the first listed (counting rule); noted under B34. Effective 2025-03-20 after delay rule 90 FR 9609 (not an event: date only); mandatory compliance 2027-09-01, all new vehicles must newly comply = re-opens approval/certification. DERIVED.

what_changed: Batteries Regulation adopted: EV-battery BMS must hold up-to-date SoH / expected-lifetime parameters (Annex VII) with read-only access and a BMS software reset function (Art. 14, from 2024-08-18); battery passport with unique identifier (Art. 77, from 2027-02-18)
note: First adoption in window. Applies to every EV battery placed on the market from the stated dates (newly comply by date); new data-access interface. DERIVED.

what_changed: Edition 2 (DC EV supply equipment): adds bidirectional power transfer control (Annex DD), communication and energy-transfer process (Annex GG), thermal-management energy transfer; system A/B/C annexes updated
note: Supply-equipment standard; vehicle-side consequence is the matching charge-control sequence on the existing link, read as software-only (BPT itself optional). DERIVED.

what_changed: Supplement 3 to 07 series: definition of second-level warning amended (activation conditions)

what_changed: Supplement 2 to 08 series: rear-seat visual warning may omit unoccupied seats where occupancy status is available; exemption continuity
note: AC.1 vote 2020-11-11 (1155). Same text as 07-S6. DERIVED.

what_changed: 09 series: safety-belt reminder changes incl. new requirements for connection of the reminder system of removable seats (8.4.6), no false warnings, visual-warning colour/symbol and second-level activation; ISOFIX/anti-rotation definitions
note: AC.1 vote 2023-11-15 (1175). New series; removable-seat reminder connection is a new interface. DERIVED.

note: AC.1 vote 2026-06-24 (1192). New data output for ADS vehicles only. DERIVED.

what_changed: New UN Regulation on cyber security and cyber security management system: CSMS certificate, risk assessment, Annex 5 threat/mitigation catalogue, protection of the vehicle type
note: AC.1 vote 2020-06-24 (ECE/TRANS/WP.29/1153). All new vehicles must newly comply by stated dates (re-opens approval); mitigations imply secure communication / key storage on connected ECUs. Vehicle-level instrument (L-1). DERIVED.

what_changed: Supplement 1: legacy relief for type approvals first issued before 2024-07-01 (CSMS-development and technically infeasible Annex 5 mitigations, with alternative mitigation and feasibility assessment)
note: AC.1 vote 2022-03-09 (1164). Process obligation changed (relaxation). DERIVED.

what_changed: Supplement 2: Annex 5 threat 4.1 extended to spoofing of V2X / GNSS messages; mitigation M10 vehicle shall verify authenticity and integrity of received messages
note: AC.1 vote 2023-06-21 (1173). Risk-assessment catalogue change reaching every ECU's CSMS lifecycle; for the domain-B ECU no new crypto implied (V2X/GNSS not received by it). DERIVED.

what_changed: Supplement 3: scope extended to category L vehicles; legacy relief for L types first approved before 2029-07-01
note: AC.1 vote 2024-06-26 (1179). L-category vehicles (incl. their battery ECUs) newly brought under CSMS approval. DERIVED.

what_changed: New edition of the digital communication protocol between off-board conductive charger and EV (title broadened from charger-BMS protocol); catalogue entry only
note: Partial access (L-3): communication-protocol title.

what_changed: FMVSS 305 amended (GTR 13 electrical safety): electrical isolation monitoring with driver warning (fuel-cell DC sources), shock protection during charging, indicators of possible active driving mode and drive-away prevention while connected to external charging
note: New operational requirements apply to all new vehicles from the compliance date (newly comply by date); interlock/indicator functions in charge control. DERIVED.

what_changed: 03 series: REESS/vehicle must signal warnings for operational failure of REESS controls (6.13), thermal event (6.14) and thermal propagation advance warning (6.15); low-energy warning; isolation monitoring; new transitional provisions

what_changed: Supplement 1 to 04 series: scope extended to category O trailers with e-axle-charged batteries; active-driving-possible mode for trailers
note: AC.1 vote 2024-11-13 (1181). Same text as 03-S4. DERIVED.

note: AC.1 vote 2025-03-05 (1184). Same text as 04-S2. DERIVED.

what_changed: Supplement 2 to 04 series: same changes as 03-S5 (advance-warning condition, common-space display, documentation)

what_changed: Supplement 1 to 05 series: vehicles without driver (categories X/Y); while ADSF-2 active, REESS/isolation warnings transmitted as a logic signal to the ADS

note: AC.1 vote 2025-11-12 (1188). New series with transitional provisions re-opening approval. DERIVED.

what_changed: Euro 7 adopted: in-vehicle battery durability (SOCE/SOCR monitors, minimum performance requirements), on-board monitoring and environmental vehicle passport data for M1/N1 electrified vehicles
note: First adoption in window; new type approvals and later all new registrations must comply by stated dates. DERIVED.

what_changed: Implementing act: type-approval procedures incl. in-vehicle battery durability; prohibition of software/calibration updates manipulating battery durability data and duty to disclose updates affecting that data

what_changed: Implementing act: OBM system and data incl. battery durability parameters (on-board SOCE/SOCR, odometer), storage, OBD access and over-the-air transmission of OBM data to manufacturer servers with R155 cybersecurity; EVP format and communication
note: New data schema, storage and OTA telemetry stack for HV energy data. Corrigendum 32025R1707R(01) not counted. DERIVED.

what_changed: FMVSS 208 appendix A-1 child restraint list updated for testing advanced air bag suppression / occupant classification (phase-in 40% from 2025-09-01, all from 2026-09-01)
note: Occupant classification must handle new, heavier CRSs; industry comment cites air bag system and software changes; all vehicles newly comply by date. DERIVED.

what_changed: FMVSS 208 seat belt warning: rear-seat belt warning required; driver warning enhanced and extended to front outboard passenger
note: Compliance originally 2026-09-01 (front) / 2027-09-01 (rear); rear buckle sensing on all rear seats. Also amends FMVSS 101 (not listed). Effective date delayed by 90 FR 9610 (not an event). DERIVED.

what_changed: Interim final rule: seat belt warning compliance dates delayed (to 2028-09-01) and regulatory text clarified (front audible first-phase warning at least 30 s; rear visual warning visibility for vehicles without driver seat)
